name: cloudflare-publish
description: Publish local web apps, APIs, or machine-only SSH from your Mac through Cloudflare Tunnel.

interface.shortDescription: Share apps and APIs from your Mac
interface.longDescription: Give a web app, private API, authenticated callback, or existing SSH server on your Mac a stable hostname. The agent uses the separately installed cloudflare-publish CLI to plan changes, manage Access, verify routes, and recover interrupted work. Requires cloudflared, your own Cloudflare account with an active full DNS zone and API token, and a local macOS executor. SSH is machine-only and requires a trusted Ed25519 host-key pin, client-side cloudflared, and separate SSH login credentials. Installing or removing this guidance does not create, stop, or retire publications.
defaultPrompt: Use Cloudflare Publish to plan a protected hostname for my local web app.
Use Cloudflare Publish to inspect my tunnel manager and explain the next safe action.
